The '''EXP-7(a) Predator''' was an experimental but powerful [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Exotac Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A large and bulky rifle, the hunter [[Kaori Batta]] owned one of the three existing EXP-7(a) models, and later used it to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[modrol]], a large predatory creature, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]].

==Description==
The EXP-7(a) Predator [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] was large and cumbersome, but it was also extremely powerful and accurate. The blaster rifle had a dual-[[Laser/Legends|laser]] targeting system and had to be carried strapped to the owner's back when not in use. The EXP-7(a) had a maximum firing range of 350 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], was very loud when fired, and had a significant recoil. The rifle used a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] that gave it a capacity of eight shots and cost 7,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new. Its ownership was highly restricted by law to specially authorized individuals.<ref name="WHSV" />

==History==
The EXP-7(a) Predator was a prototype blaster rifle created by [[Exotac Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Only three were ever made, one of which was given to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] big game hunter [[Kaori Batta]] to field test on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. The other two models were kept at the Exotac [[Laboratory/Legends|labs]].<ref name="WHSV" />

During a hunting expedition that started at [[Exovar's Emporium]] on Neftali, Batta used the rifle to [[Death/Legends|bring down]] an [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[modrol]], a large predatory creature that had killed the [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] [[Ghecharo]] and had nearly killed Ghecharo's [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]], [[Kleck]].<ref name="WHSV" />

Batta gave a demonstration of the rifle's power to some tourists on Neftali. The blast went through the target, a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] behind the target, and damaged a [[rock]] behind the tree. A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Dykara]] witnessed the demonstration and asked Batta if they could acquire a copy of the blaster rifle.<ref name="gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The EXP-7(a) Predator was first mentioned in the sourcebook ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[January]] [[1997]].
